Class Player

java.lang.Object
gamemode.lobby.Player.Player
public class Player extends Object
The Player class represents the controllable character in the lobby game mode.

This class manages all player-related attributes including:

  • Core statistics (HP, strength, level, experience)
  • Inventory management
  • Movement and position handling
  • Animation rendering
  • Item purchasing and selling
  • Potion usage and temporary buffs
  • Level progression system

The player supports temporary buffs such as:

  • Experience Boost
  • Speed Boost

Rendering is handled via JavaFX GraphicsContext.

This class follows a state-based structure where movement, animation, and buffs are updated dynamically.
